title: Simple
tagline: Decentralised documentation tool empowering liquidity and security through tokens.
description:
The project allows users to add your documentation/writing and submit it to IPFS, making it decentralised and minting them as dynamic NFTs, really making it decentralised and ownable, with the functionality of adding collaborators and adding it to the metadata of the NFT, making it on chain collaborations and accountability. 

And hosted at Valist at https://bafybeicj5c3ydxdjpvdg7u7lb2ft3ssrgbuzdbvkyqi7wdoey7xqhoesfy.ipfs.dweb.link/
how_its_made: This Project Uses React, Solidity, NodeJS, TailwindCSS and @IPFS as a decentralised storage location for the documents storage and minting them as NFTs on @Polygon and for minting NFTs we are using @NFTPort API suites to mint dynamic NFTs and hosting the platform on @Valist to make a decentralised app with a decentralised hosting service over @IPFS.
